full_details: You left Woodstock in the dark. Bread and cheese at Chipping Norton at ten. The rain began on the ridge and was steady by the time the old stones were somewhere off to the left. You did not turn aside. At Shipston the vowels were your own. A boy held the bay while you wrung the cloak. The last miles you rode wet through, and the lath sword and the ribbons stayed dry in the bag. Three days on the road come to a hundred and two miles. Richard was at the far end of the bridge, sent at four, and he began the town's news with the hay. By the door you had stopped rehearsing. Anne had flour on her forearms. The sword went to Hamnet, the ribbons to Judith, the riddle-book to Susanna, who opened it at once. You did not deliver the opinion you had promised to carry, and you did not put a speech on top of the day.
one_sentence: You came wet over the bridge and put the gifts into the right hands.
title: Came over the bridge and gave out the gifts
